unterminated_string.title: unterminated string
unterminated_string.help: did you forget a closing quote?

unexpected_token.title: unexpected token
unexpected_token.help: this token is not valid here; check for a missing delimiter or keyword before it

expected_token.title: expected a different token
expected_token.help: the parser expected a specific token here; verify punctuation and keywords

unclosed_delimiter.title: unclosed delimiter
unclosed_delimiter.help: a '(' '[' or '{' was opened but not closed on this path

trailing_or_extra_token.title: trailing or extra token
trailing_or_extra_token.help: remove extra punctuation or a stray comma at the end of the list

invalid_assignment_target.title: invalid assignment target
invalid_assignment_target.help: only names, tuple patterns, or index/field targets may appear on the left of an assignment

undefined_name.title: undefined name
undefined_name.help: this name is not defined in the current scope

arity_mismatch.title: arity mismatch in grouped binding
arity_mismatch.help: the number of names on the left must equal the number of values on the right

redeclared_symbol.title: name already defined in this scope
redeclared_symbol.help: choose a different name or remove the earlier declaration

type_mismatch.title: type mismatch
type_mismatch.help: the expression does not have the expected type

wrong_return_kind.title: return type mismatch
wrong_return_kind.help: the returned expression does not match the function's declared return type

assign_to_immutable.title: cannot assign to immutable variable
assign_to_immutable.help: declare the variable with 'mut' if you intend to reassign it

not_public.title: symbol is not public
not_public.help: symbols imported from another module must be declared with 'pub'

public_const_not_const.title: public constant must be compile-time constant
public_const_not_const.help: public constants must be literal compile-time values

pub_let_mut_forbidden.title: public let cannot be mutable
pub_let_mut_forbidden.help: remove 'mut' from public top-level let declarations

use_none_not_void.title: use 'none' instead of 'void'
use_none_not_void.help: Desi does not have 'void'; use 'none' for no-value types

reserved_identifier.title: reserved keyword used as an identifier
reserved_identifier.help: choose a different name; language keywords and special names cannot be used as identifiers

shadow_builtin.title: cannot shadow prelude builtin
shadow_builtin.help: rename your binding; builtins like 'len' and 'print' cannot be redefined

import_name_conflict.title: name conflicts with imported symbol
import_name_conflict.help: rename your declaration; imported names cannot be redefined

use_none_instead_of_void.title: 'void' is not a type; use 'none'
use_none_instead_of_void.help: Desi uses 'none' to denote no value. Replace 'void' with 'none'.

unsupported_assignment_target.title: unsupported assignment target
unsupported_assignment_target.help: the left-hand side must be a name, index, or field expression

unknown_struct_type.title: unknown struct type
unknown_struct_type.help: this struct type is not defined

field_access_on_non_struct.title: field access on non-struct
field_access_on_non_struct.help: only struct values support field access

cannot_assign_field_on_non_struct.title: cannot assign to field on non-struct
cannot_assign_field_on_non_struct.help: the left-hand side must be a struct value

illegal_defer_position.title: defer is not allowed here
illegal_defer_position.help: move the 'defer' to the function top level

bad_condition_type.title: invalid condition type
bad_condition_type.help: conditions must be bool or int

symbol_not_value.title: symbol is not a value
symbol_not_value.help: call the function or refer to a constant/type as appropriate

unknown_symbol_in_module_alias.title: unknown symbol in module alias
unknown_symbol_in_module_alias.help: verify the symbol name exported by that module

unknown_field_on_struct.title: unknown field on struct
unknown_field_on_struct.help: check the field name against the struct definition

unknown_enum_variant.title: unknown enum variant
unknown_enum_variant.help: verify the variant name declared in the enum

duplicate_match_arm.title: duplicate match arm
duplicate_match_arm.help: each variant should appear at most once

payloadless_variant_binder.title: payloadless variant used with a binder
payloadless_variant_binder.help: remove the binder or use a variant that carries a payload

await_outside_async.title: `await` is only valid inside async functions

await_non_future.title: cannot await a non-future value
await_non_future.help: Only values of kind `future<T>` can be awaited.

builtin_wrong_arity.title: wrong number of arguments
builtin_wrong_arity.help: check the function's signature and adjust the number of arguments

builtin_arg_void.title: argument is void
builtin_arg_void.help: arguments must produce a value; remove expressions of kind 'none'

builtin_arg_unsupported_kind.title: unsupported argument kind
builtin_arg_unsupported_kind.help: convert the expression to a supported kind (int/float/str/bool)

call_wrong_arity.title: wrong number of arguments
call_wrong_arity.help: pass exactly the required number of arguments

module_call_wrong_arity.title: wrong number of arguments
module_call_wrong_arity.help: verify the arity of the function exported by that module

enum_ctor_wrong_arity.title: wrong number of arguments
enum_ctor_wrong_arity.help: constructors for payloadless variants take no arguments; payloadful ones take exactly one

incompatible_struct_assignment.title: incompatible struct assignment
incompatible_struct_assignment.help: assign a value of the same struct type

incompatible_enum_assignment.title: incompatible enum assignment
incompatible_enum_assignment.help: assign a value of the same enum type/variant

import_cycle.title: import cycle
import_cycle.help: break the cycle by removing or refactoring one of the imports

missing_module.title: cannot find module
missing_module.help: verify the dotted path and ensure the file exists under a search root (project dir or compiler/lib)

duplicate_import.title: duplicate import
duplicate_import.help: remove the repeated import; importing the same module multiple times has no effect

unused_variable.title: unused variable or parameter
unused_variable.help: Prefix the name with '_' to silence this warning.

missing_explicit_return.title: function may fall through without an explicit return

non_exhaustive_match.title: non-exhaustive match
non_exhaustive_match.help: add arms for the missing variants or a wildcard '_' arm

c_backend_generic.title: C backend error
c_backend_generic.help: This code isn’t supported by the C backend. Consider the LLVM backend or adjust types.

unsupported_return_type.title: unsupported return type
unsupported_return_type.help: Use i8/i16/i32/i64/isize, u8/u16/u32/u64/usize, bool, str, f32, or f64. Otherwise use --backend=llvm.

unknown_return_type.title: unknown return type
unknown_return_type.help: Define the type (struct/enum) or switch to --backend=llvm.

non_async_returns_future.title: non-async function returns future
non_async_returns_future.help: Mark the function 'async' or change the return type.

param_none_not_allowed.title: parameter cannot have type 'none'
param_none_not_allowed.help: Use a concrete type for parameters.

param_future_not_supported.title: parameter cannot have type 'future' in C backend
param_future_not_supported.help: Pass concrete values; futures aren’t supported as parameters in the C backend.

unsupported_param_type.title: unsupported parameter type
unsupported_param_type.help: Use the supported scalar set or switch to --backend=llvm.

unknown_param_type.title: unknown parameter type
unknown_param_type.help: Define the type or switch to --backend=llvm.

field_future_not_supported.title: struct field cannot have type 'future'
field_future_not_supported.help: Store a concrete value instead of a future when targeting C.

unsupported_field_type.title: unsupported struct field type
unsupported_field_type.help: Use the supported scalar set or switch to --backend=llvm.

unknown_field_type.title: unknown struct field type
unknown_field_type.help: Define the field type or switch to --backend=llvm.

enum_payload_future_not_supported.title: enum payload cannot be 'future'
enum_payload_future_not_supported.help: Choose a supported payload type or use --backend=llvm.

enum_payload_unsupported.title: unsupported enum payload type
enum_payload_unsupported.help: Use supported scalars for payloads or switch to --backend=llvm.

enum_payload_unknown.title: unknown enum payload type
enum_payload_unknown.help: Define the payload type or switch to --backend=llvm.

type_alias_future_not_supported.title: type alias cannot target 'future'
type_alias_future_not_supported.help: Alias a supported type when targeting C.

type_alias_unsupported.title: unsupported type alias target
type_alias_unsupported.help: Alias a supported scalar or use --backend=llvm.

type_alias_unknown.title: unknown type alias target
type_alias_unknown.help: Define the target type or switch to --backend=llvm.
